arena: [생존기] With Spirit of the Redeemer, you can activate Spirit of Redemption yourself: for 6 sec you can't be targeted by attacks or spells and your heals are free. Press it right before focus fire takes you down.
[분담] Guardian Spirit increases the target's healing taken by 60% for 10 sec and prevents one fatal hit. Put it on the ally the enemy burst is focused on.
[회피] With Phase Shift, Fade makes you avoid all attacks and spells for 1 sec, but not interrupts. Press Fade the moment an enemy CC cast finishes.
[제어] Psychic Scream makes enemies within 8 yds flee in fear for 8 sec. With Psychic Shroud, hitting a player blocks the next CC effect on you within 6 sec.

[해제] Purify removes all harmful magic effects from an ally, and Mass Dispel removes harmful magic from 5 allies within 15 yds, including magic normal dispels can't remove. Use Mass Dispel when several allies are CC'd.
[위치] With Phantasm, Fade removes all slows, and Angelic Feather increases movement speed by 40% for 5 sec. When slowed, use these to break line of sight behind a pillar.
[생존기] Desperate Prayer increases your max health by 25% for 10 sec and instantly heals you for that amount. Press it first when focus fire starts.
[분담] Power Infusion increases the target player's Haste by 20% for 15 sec. Apply it when your DPS pops their burst cooldowns.
bg: [참고] Battleground Blitz groups run 2 healers, and on flag maps a mobile healer is a good carrier. You can help carry by shaking slows with Angelic Feather and Fade via Phantasm.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. For a focused flag carrier, apply Guardian Spirit first: it increases healing taken by 60% and prevents one death.
[분담] Leap of Faith instantly pulls an ally in front of you. Pull a pinned flag carrier back toward your team.
[제어] Enemies feared by Psychic Scream can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
[광역 피해] Divine Hymn heals party and raid members within 40 yds over 5 sec, and each heal increases healing taken by 4%. Use it when allies stacked on base defense take AoE damage.
pvpTalents: Spirit of the Redeemer, picked by all top 37 Solo Shuffle players and 41 of 42 Battleground Blitz players, turns Spirit of Redemption into a self-activated 6 sec invulnerable healing form every 2 min. Phase Shift, picked by all 37 Solo Shuffle and 39 of 42 Battleground Blitz players, makes you avoid all attacks and spells for 1 sec on Fade. Sanctified Ground, picked by 29 of 42 Battleground Blitz players, protects allies standing on Holy Word: Sanctify ground from silences and interrupts for 5 sec.

215769.d: The Priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 6 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the Priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.

215982.m: Tank Specs – Row 1 PvP Talent · Replaces Spirit of Redemption
215982.d: Your Spirit of Redemption is now an active ability with a 2 minute cooldown, but the duration is reduced by 9 sec and you will no longer enter Spirit of Redemption upon dying.

408557.d:
Step into the shadows when you cast Fade, avoiding all attacks and spells for 1 sec.

Interrupt effects are not affected by Phase Shift.

1246968.d: When your Psychic Scream affects 1 or more players, the next crowd control effect against you is prevented. Lasts 6 sec.

215769.d: 사제가 6초 동안 구원의 영혼이 됩니다. 구원의 영혼은 이동 및 공격을 할 수 없지만, 주문 및 기타 효과의 대상이 되거나 공격을 받지도 않습니다. 구원의 영혼 상태에서는 모든 치유 주문을 자원 소모 없이 사용할 수 있습니다.

215982.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 구원의 영혼을(를) 대신함
215982.d: 구원의 영혼이 이제 사용 능력이 되고 2분의 재사용 대기시간이 적용됩니다. 하지만 지속시간이 9초로 감소하고, 사망 시 구원의 영혼이 되지 않습니다.

408557.d:
소실 시전 시 그림자에 숨어들어 1초 동안 모든 공격과 주문을 회피합니다.

주문 방해 효과는 위상 변화에 영향을 받지 않습니다.

1246968.d: 영혼의 절규가 1명 이상의 플레이어에게 영향을 주면 자신에게 걸리는 다음 군중 제어 효과를 방지합니다. 6초 동안 지속됩니다.

note: There is no spec-specific PvP guide source, so these are general principles built from ability and PvP talent tooltips, actual top-player pick rates, and mode and map requirements.

unverified: Sanctified Ground는 툴팁상 성역화 권능에 붙는데 이번 시즌 Ultimate Serenity가 성역화 대상 특성을 평온 권능으로 옮겨 실제 발동 기술이 불확실해 전략 줄에는 쓰지 않음
notes: 상위권 영웅 특성이 거의 모두 예언자(1인 조합전 37/37)지만 지침대로 한쪽 전용 기술은 쓰지 않음
